events.verdict: Young (ATL) and Suggs (ORL) briefly engage off-ball as Suggs places his hand on Young, and Young attempts to separate.
Suggs (ORL) grasps and then quickly releases Young's (ATL) jersey off-ball.

Suggs (ORL) initiates contact as he wraps his left arm around Young's (ATL) upper body and pulls him forward in an attempt to draw an offensive foul. Although Young does extend both hands into Suggs' front, the initial illegal contact was from Suggs, and a defensive foul is correctly assessed.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) is already in Banchero's (ORL) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Banchero (ORL) legally contests Alexander-Walker's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball, and although he does not dislodge it away from Suggs, no contact occurred with his arm.
Okongwu (ATL) faces Carter Jr. (ORL) up and impedes his ability to pursue the rebound.
Daniels (ATL) brings his right hand to Wagner's (ORL) right arm, and marginal contact occurs as Daniels is defending around the screen during the inbound play.
Okongwu (ATL) jumps and maintains verticality when incidental contact occurs with Suggs (ORL) during the driving shot attempt.
Carter Jr (ORL) extends his hand to the front of Young's (ATL) body after his gather, and initiates contact that affects the driving shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) does not fully maintain control of the basketball when he goes to the floor.
As Alexander-Walker (ATL) secures the rebound, he and Suggs (ORL) come together at the same spot, causing marginal contact to occur as he is already stumbling backward.
Gueye (ATL) maintains control of the ball and requests a timeout prior to any ORL player being able to make contact with the ball simultaneously. A timeout is correctly granted to ATL.
Wagner (ORL) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
